# The script env command sets empty values but cannot unset a variable.
# Use the host env utility to remove GOEXPERIMENT from the driver environment.
[short] skip 'links and runs test binaries'
[GOOS:windows] skip 'requires env -u'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'requires env -u'
[!exec:env] skip 'requires env -u'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# logos injects its effective experiment into test processes. Absent and
# present-empty driver values therefore have identical observable inputs.
exec env -u GOEXPERIMENT logos test -v .
! stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="logosarena"'
exec env -u GOEXPERIMENT logos test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="logosarena"'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="logosarena"'
logos test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="logosarena"'

# Changing the effective experiment changes the test's input and cache entry.
env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
logos test -v .
! stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="nojsonv2,logosarena"'
logos test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="nojsonv2,logosarena"'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value="logosarena"'

# Plain go preserves the caller's environment and must distinguish presence.
exec env -u GOEXPERIMENT go test -v .
! stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=false value=""'
exec env -u GOEXPERIMENT go test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=false value=""'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
go test -v .
! stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value=""'
go test -v .
stdout '\(cached\)'
stdout 'GOEXPERIMENT present=true value=""'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/testcacheexperiment

go 1.27

-- experiment_test.go --
package experiment

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestExperimentPresence(t *testing.T) {
	value, present := os.LookupEnv("GOEXPERIMENT")
	t.Logf("GOEXPERIMENT present=%t value=%q", present, value)
}
